description: Delayed task start for the one-run level-4 schedule (design section 5, resolved decision 3: ONE level-4 run with deform starting at step 3000 and a 500-step per-task LR ramp; the two-stage chain stays a script-only fallback). New --task-start-step 'task:step' and --task-start-ramp-steps W; TaskSchedule renormalises over active tasks (identical draws when all active); fit() multiplies lr on the delayed task's ramp steps. Defaults bit-identical. Also the short local level-4 end-to-end run (design 12.4). Depends on FEAT-001 (adamw in the e2e) and should follow FEAT-003 (both edit runtime/run.py::fit and runtime/args.py).
steps: runtime/args.py (tasks and losses group near --task-ratio l.217): --task-start-step SPEC (str, default None) and --task-start-ramp-steps W (int, default 0). In parse_args AFTER `if args.overfit_one_group: args.steps = args.overfit_max_steps` (so the start < steps check uses the final step count): parse 'task:step' comma list -> args.task_start_steps_parsed {task: int} (only listed tasks; {} when None); errors via parser.error: unknown task or task not in --task-ratio (name it), negative or non-integer step, duplicate task, a start >= --steps ('would never train'), no task starting at 0 (counting unlisted ratio tasks as 0), W < 0, W > 0 without any listed start > 0 ('--task-start-ramp-steps needs a --task-start-step entry > 0'). train_config_from_args passes task_start_steps and task_start_ramp_steps.

runtime/run.py: TrainConfig.task_start_steps: Dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict), task_start_ramp_steps: int = 0. TaskSchedule(ratio, seed=0, start_steps=None): keep today's _cum table and draw code; add active_tasks(step); draw(step): if every task is active use today's path exactly (single-task shortcut included); otherwise compute u identically (random.Random(seed * 1000003 + step).random()) and use a cumulative table over the active tasks in ratio order, renormalised, cached per active-set tuple; a single active task returns it without a draw. Trainer constructs TaskSchedule(cfg.task_ratio, cfg.seed, cfg.task_start_steps). Trainer.__init__ re-validates (tasks in ratio, starts >= 0, one task at 0, W >= 0) with ValueError.

runtime/run.py fit(): after `lr = lr_at(s, cfg.schedule)`: start = cfg.task_start_steps.get(task, 0); if start > 0 and W > 0 and s < start + W: lr *= (s - start + 1) / W; then O.set_learning_rate(self.optimizer, lr) (logged rec['lr'] is the applied value). No multiplication otherwise (bit-identical default). Validation unchanged (a not-yet-started deform set reports identity-level values).

tests/test_trainer.py (TestTaskSchedule l.73 and a new TrainerCase/DeformCase test): 11.4 a (no starts == today's draws for steps 0..9999 exactly - compare against a TaskSchedule built without start_steps and against a hard-coded replica of the old loop), b (deform:3000 -> no deform before 3000; rigid/affine ~1:1 before, 1:1:2 after within 0.02 over 20000 draws; deterministic), c (LR ramp: applied lr on delayed-task steps == lr_at(s) * (s - start + 1) / W inside the ramp, == lr_at(s) after; other tasks unchanged - read trainer.history rec['lr']), e (short Trainer run TINY synthetic three-task, 12 steps, start deform:6: no deform step before 6, at least one after, all finite). tests/test_main.py: 11.4 d parser errors (unknown task, task not in ratio, start >= steps, no task at 0, negative values, duplicates, W > 0 without a start > 0).

Local end-to-end at level 4 (design 12.4): run main.py in WSL tf_gpu with BGR_TF_GPU_LIMIT_MB=6000-equivalent memory limit (pass --gpu-memory-limit-mb 6000 or the env used by tests), tiny widths (copy the tiny/narrow --filters/--reductions/--dense/--decoder-widths used by tests/test_main.py), `--level 4 --overfit-one-group --overfit-synthetic --task-ratio rigid:1,affine:1,deform:2 --optimizer adamw --weight-decay 1e-2 --task-start-step deform:6 --task-start-ramp-steps 4 --amp true --overfit-max-steps 20 --overfit-threshold-mm 0 --results <temp dir under .agents/tasks/retrain-prereqs/e2e_tmp> --log-backend jsonl` (check main.py's real flag names first). Confirm: exit code 0 or 1 (overfit threshold not reached is exit 1 and acceptable), metrics.jsonl has no deform step before step 6 and deform steps after, all losses finite, config.json has the optimizer record. Record the command and result in findings and in .agents/tasks/retrain-prereqs/e2e_level4.txt, then delete the temp results dir.
